_comment: music_echo pads, low to high left to right. Each has a rest and a hit frame; show the hit frame for the length of the note. The order here is the pitch order — synthesis should follow it. draw_scale trends down left to right; drawn width does not, because the wood blocks are two objects side by side.
_cap_note: A round is a round, so the <=6 cap applies. Four keeps the sequence short enough to hold.
